title: TXAM Makes a Stunning Debut at CIBF International Battery Exhibition, "Cyclic Automatic Elevator" Attracts Much Attention
contentHtml:
In May 2025, TXAM showcased its independently developed core equipment such as the "Cyclic Automatic Elevator" at the CIBF International Battery Technology Exhibition, fully entering the new energy and intelligent warehousing and logistics sectors.

New Energy Sector Layout

Under the guidance of the "dual carbon" goals, the new energy industry is booming, and the demand for automation equipment is growing rapidly. TXAM has seized this opportunity by establishing a new energy intelligent equipment R&D team, focusing on the development and manufacturing of equipment for lithium battery module PACK production lines, intelligent warehousing and logistics systems, and other fields.

Core Product Showcase

The "Cyclic Automatic Elevator" exhibited this time adopts an advanced servo drive system and precision guide rail structure, featuring smooth operation, precise positioning, and high efficiency. It can be widely applied in new energy battery warehousing and logistics scenarios.

During the exhibition, the TXAM booth attracted numerous domestic and international customers for visits and negotiations, and multiple cooperation intentions were reached on site.
